card.name: PH in CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY cross-references
card.fires_on: The piece "PH" in the capitalized heading "CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY", when it appears in a parenthetical "(see CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY)" cross-reference in a drug label.

modes.label: Cross-reference to section
modes.description: "PH" right after "CLINICAL" inside a "see ..." pointer to the pharmacology section.
modes.example: Renal excretion is the major route of elimination for carboplatin (see CLINICAL<< PH>>ARMACOLOGY ).

card.writes: It pushes toward word pieces like "farm" and away from "dr", which seems unrelated to the text and gives no useful effect here.
card.plain: It lights up on the start of the word PHARMACOLOGY when a label points the reader to the Clinical Pharmacology section.
